section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Transmission Case and Rear Brake Pistons)
title: Transmission Case and Rear Brake Pistons

content.description: Exploded view diagram showing transmission case and rear brake piston assembly components in disassembled order from left to right
Cross-sectional diagram showing SST (Special Service Tool) installed in transmission case to compress return springs

content.text: DISASSEMBLY OF TRANSMISSION CASE AND REAR BRAKE PISTONS
1. COMPRESS RETURN SPRINGS AND REMOVE SPRING RETAINER SNAP RING

items: (a) Install the SST. Gradually and evenly tighten the bolt to compress the springs, being careful not to damage the transmission case with SST.
(b) Using a screwdriver and hook, remove the snap ring.

content.description: Top-down view diagram showing circular spring retainer with sixteen springs arranged radially around the perimeter
